NOTICE AND CALL OF A SPECIAL MEETING
OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF AZUSA
TO THE MEMBERS OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF AZUSA:
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, that a Special Meeting of the Planning Commission is hereby called to be held on TUESDAY, DECEMBER 17, 2024 at 7:00 p.m. at the Azusa Auditorium, located at 213 E. Foothill Blvd, Azusa, California 91702.
Said Special Meeting shall be for discussing, hearing and taking action on the items listed below:
AGENDA

628 N. Pasadena Avenue (DR-2022-28, TTM-084449) ? The City of Azusa Planning Commission will consider a Design Review to allow the construction of a 3-story, 6-unit condominium building with attached parking on a 7,700 square-foot lot and a Tentative Tract Map for the subdivision the existing parcel into six (6) air parcels. The project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Guidelines Section 15332 (Class 32 ? Infill Development). This item was previously considered at the October 9, 2024 Planning Commission Meeting.
Item G-1
2.
555 W. Danlee Street (UP-2024-02/MUP-2020-15 MOD) ? The City of Azusa Planning Commission will consider Use Permit No. UP-2024-02 and modification to Minor Use Permit No. MUP-2020-15 to allow operation of a construction contractor business with extended hours of operation. The MUP modification would amend the existing conditions of approval to address noise concerns associated with the requested start time of 5 am. The project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Guidelines Section 15301 (Class 1 ? Existing Facilities). This item was previously considered at the October 9, 2024 Planning Commission Meeting.
